# A negative main step on a whole substep clock: the load leaves Bullet's
# substep remainder at 0, and from frame 15 with 50 ms passes the first pass
# runs three catch-up substeps and leaves -0x1p-28 s for the main step
# (budget.py 50 1 15). The remainder goes below 0, so the first settle step of
# that pass runs no substep.
settle 0
load pmm swing600.pmm
trace negstep.trace
play 15 120
pump 20 50
stop
save pmm negstep.pmm
